responsibility: Implements the crate-level driver for gccrs borrow checking. It collects borrow-check-eligible HIR functions, builds a fresh BIR for each one, optionally writes per-function BIR dumps to disk, then runs the BIR fact collector to prepare Polonius input; it also reports the current unimplemented status for closure borrow checking, so this file sequences the end-to-end borrow-check pipeline rather than defining BIR structures or individual lowering rules.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable crate-level borrow-check pipeline in the borrowck directory: directory/file dumping helpers, function collection, per-function BIR building, optional dump emission, fact collection, and closure-not-supported diagnostics; unlike the matching header, it is the implementation of the pass driver rather than its minimal public declaration.
